Drishyam is a photography discovery app made to celebrate beautiful places, fleeting moments and the details we often overlook. Explore photographs from Unsplash, save the ones you love, and set them as wallpaper.\n\nPhotographers deserve credit: attribution and the original photo link are available with each image.

Some of the best ideas begin in ordinary places. Savan Jee, a BBA student, and Akshat Jha, a BCA student, met in their college hostel. What began as friendship grew through everyday conversations, shared ambitions and the wish to build something of their own.

They came from different academic worlds, but shared a belief that creativity and determination could become something meaningful. That spirit became part of Drishyam.

Built with friendship. Driven by curiosity. Inspired by the world around us.
Minimal design, quick browsing, and a place for your favourite images.
Attribution and original-source links are shown wherever available.
A little corner for the photographs I choose to share.
Planned as a public collection: everyone can browse and download, and only the developer account can upload or remove images. The secure cloud connection is not active yet.
